settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: We dispatch orders within 1–2 business days, and delivery typically takes 5–12 business days. You'll receive a tracking link by email as soon as your order ships, so you can follow it the whole way.

settings.question: Is it safe to leave on overnight?
settings.answer: Yes. There's no real flame, and the unit shuts off automatically when the water runs low — so it's safe to leave running overnight or around children and pets.

settings.question: Does it use a real flame?
settings.answer: No. The flame is an illusion made of cool mist lit by warm LEDs — no fire, no heat, no smoke or soot.

settings.question: What essential oils can I use?
settings.answer: Any water-soluble essential oil. Add 3–5 drops to a full tank. Avoid fragrance oils, carrier oils or anything oil-based without water, as these can damage the ultrasonic plate.

settings.question: How do I change the flame colour?
settings.answer: Press the power button once to turn the flame on, then press it again to cycle through the colours until you reach the one you like.

settings.question: Can I return it if I don't like it?
settings.answer: Yes — you're covered by our 30-day money-back guarantee. If it's not for you, email lumiscastore@outlook.com within 30 days for a full refund.

settings.heading: How to use the light
settings.body:
• Press the power button once to turn the flame on
  • Press again to cycle through flame colours
  • Hold for 3 seconds to switch between continuous and intermittent mist

settings.heading: Essential oils
settings.body: Compatible with any water-soluble essential oil. Add 3–5 drops to a full tank. Do not use fragrance oils, carrier oils or anything oil-based without water — these can damage the ultrasonic plate and will void your warranty. Never run the unit dry.

settings.heading: Cleaning and care
settings.body: Unplug and empty the tank after each use. Wipe the inside with a soft dry cloth. Once a week, clean the ultrasonic plate with a cotton bud dampened with white vinegar, then wipe dry. Do not submerge the unit in water and do not put any part of it in a dishwasher.

settings.heading: Warranty and returns
settings.body: Every Lumisca diffuser is covered by a 12-month warranty against manufacturing defects, plus our 30-day money-back guarantee. Email lumiscastore@outlook.com with your order number and we'll sort it.
